Hard timeout of about 40 ms... falls back to stand-in rules... It never just approves or declines blindly.
define features once (Feast, Tecton or an in-house DSL) and build training sets with point-in-time correct joins

Approve, Decline, Step-up (3DS challenge, OTP, push to the app), Approve + queue for review
